message: リア先生の青空教室

name: Ria
message: 「Ms. Leah's Open-Air Classroom~♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uwooooh!! Leah-chan, you're the best!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, panda」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan, you've gotten pretty used to handling Spirit Arts, haven't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Spirit... Arts?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The sacred power bestowed by the angels is the power of spirits. That is what is called Spirit Arts.」

name: Ria
message: 「You sure know a lot~. Almost like an angel who came straight from Heaven.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Whoa, it was written in the guidebook!」

name: Ria
message: 「Right. Just as Lolotte-chan said, the power that we Crusaders wield is called Spirit Arts.」

name: Ria
message: 「In contrast, the power that demons use is magic, just as the name implies.」

name: Misa
message: 「A knowledgeable big sister is also... f-a-b-u-l-o-u-s\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. Which one does my power fall under, I wonder?」
No response. It seems he's been reduced to mere ashes.

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, no, no. It's nothing at all\s01」
Close call, close call... I blurted that out on impulse. I've got to be careful so I don't get found out.

name: Ria
message: 「You see, the strength of your Spirit Power comes down to how much of the angelic power hidden inside this Rosary you can draw out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We'll just push through that part with pure spirit!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Rather than sheer spirit, concentration might be more important.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Speaking of concentration, it's Synn's time to shine. Secret Ultimate Technique: All-Night Cramming!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, I turn into an empty husk afterward」

name: Ria
message: 「After that, as long as you control the power you've drawn out well and fight in your own style, you're good to go--V for victory~\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Even a playful big sister is... so won-der-ful\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing, Ria-senpai. You really know all kinds of things」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. I'm your senpai, so it's only natural」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's our battle-hardened Valkyrie for you」

name: Ria
message: 「W-When you put it like that, it's a little embarrassing...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, what will we be doing today!? I'm so excited」

name: Ria
message: 「We don't know what kind of Demons will show up from here on out. So we have to carefully analyze their patterns and come up with countermeasures」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds just like studying for a test... My head hurts」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. If you train like it's a sport, it's not really that tough」
Ria-senpai twirls her weapon around like a baton.

name: Ria
message: 「Now then, let's start with a light mock battle. Hmmm, who should I pick?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't tell me we have to transform?」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「President, you're up!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh, me!? Misa's gonna say I'm getting a head start or--」

name: Misa
message: 「To think I get to watch Big Sister's fighting style...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「She's totally gone...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, I shall become the first star!!」

name: Synn
message: 「'Become a star' sounds ominous again...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way, Lolo-chan!! In times like this, the guy has to show off his cool side first. Right!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't 'right' me」
This is getting nowhere, so I might as well hurry up and transform.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~~ Mr. President. Looking gallant as always~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That was a splendid transformation\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see... Well, that's fine then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I didn't look, I didn't look!! I didn't see anything!! Not even a tiny bit, I tell you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're being way too obvious, Nanaka」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... Misa seems okay, at least」
Now, as for the all-important Ria-senpai――

name: Ria
message: 「A-Ah, now that you mention it, that's right, ahahahaha--\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「You saw... didn't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah」

name: Ria
message: 「B-But you know, Synn-kun. If you get embarrassed every time you transform, a Demon will catch you off guard\s01」
She's trying to save face by repeating what Helena-san said earlier.

name: Ria
message: 「Do you understand!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yesh!」

name: Ria
message: 「Good♪ Then, you're up first, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Just me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's mouth-to-mouth!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You mean man-to-man!」
No way, am I going to have a one-on-one duel with Senpai!?

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. Surely someone like you can read the room.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lose this match spectacularly. Got it?」
So I'm just supposed to be the foil to make Ria-senpai look good.

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee... The match will come a little later. First, let's start with the basics of how to fight, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, I see~ Thank goodness」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How pathetic, honestly. You're a guy, so straighten up and go for a clean win!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Think you can win, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Victory always comes down to luck, you know. Find life in the jaws of death!」

name: Misa
message: 「No way, no way. Neither of you even comes close to Senpai.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh yeah, Misa? Then how close do you think you get?!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm right at Onee-sama's knees\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The vice president really is a weird person~」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. Anyway, Synn-kun will be our example, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. Wait--what am I supposed to do, though?」

name: Ria
message: 「First, could you ready your weapon? And then--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
Senpai pressed right up against my back.

name: Ria
message: 「Stretch your arms out like this...」
Her slender fingertips wrapped tightly around my wrists.

name: Ria
message: 「Keep your elbows tucked in tight.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-Tucked in tight?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Nice and tight and cute\s04」
Why am I the only one freaking out here?!
Well, no wonder. For the past few moments, something soft has been pressing against my back, pulling away, and brushing past me.
What is this thing~--wait, if it's Ria-senpai, there's only one thing it could possibly be!!

name: Ria
message: 「And then puff your chest out--bam!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bam?!」
Ria-senpai pressed her chest hard against my back.
Plump, elastic softness shifted shape against my spine.

name: Ria
message: 「Make sure to... nnf, keep your back straight!!」
Because she kept moving around while staying pressed against me, her breasts rubbed back and forth across my back.

name: Ria
message: 「Next, spread your feet about shoulder―width―」
A shapely, well-fleshed thigh slid right between my legs.

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, did I startle you?」
My legs are forcibly pried open. Our legs stay pressed tightly together. T-This really is hands-on, step-by-step instruction.

name: Ria
message: 「You're all tensed up. You can leave yourself to me, so... relax, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yessh!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn!! You're sticking way too close to Senpai!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hurry up and switch places with me already!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't interrupt, you two! Watch closely」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm sorry!」
Ria-senpai is completely serious.
Even so, how impure am I for feeling this way!!
No, no. I won't get any practice done like this.

name: Ria
message: 「Once you're mentally ready... try aiming straight ahead. Straight ahead, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Straight ahead, straight ahead...」
Senpai is taking this seriously for my sake. I have to live up to that.
I close my eyes and focus my mind.
When I do, my senses naturally gravitate toward the parts touching Ria-senpai.
What I fired went flying off in a completely wild direction.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun」
Ria-senpai stands right in front of me, puffing out her cheeks.

name: Ria
message: 「You're nooot concentrating at all\s09」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... I'm sorry」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grinning like a fool, you pervert!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not grinning!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Flirting with Onee―sama like that makes me jeal―I mean, it's unforgivable!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? Misa-chan, what do you mean by that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're quite the sinful one, Senpai. Look how flustered the President has been this whole time.」

name: Misa
message: 「Pressing your skin against Onee―sama and snuggling up together is so enviable―I mean, impure!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... so that's what happened...」
Urgh, I'm too embarrassed to look her in the eye.

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sorry. I didn't mean for it to turn out like that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not your fault, Senpai! It's because Synn isn't taking this seriously--」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it! I'll do it seriously next time, so watch.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」
For Senpai's sake too, I have to nail it this time.
Just as I was taught, I ready my weapon and fix my posture.
I tuck my elbows in, puff out my chest, keep my back straight, and put strength into my legs to brace myself firmly.

name: Synn
message: 「Straight... straight ahead...」
Focus, focus--I found a good target. Aiming right at it, I heighten my spirit and unleash it all at once.
The wave of darkness that shoots from the tip of my halberd travels in a straight line.
A discarded empty can is launched high into the air, spinning round and round before fluttering right down into my hand.
And straight into the trash can it goes.

name: Synn
message: 「Phew~~」
I wipe the sweat from my forehead and let out a big breath. I managed to overcome my nerves somehow, though--

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... how was something like that?」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Ah, yeah! Very good, very good, keep it up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness~~」

name: Ria
message: 「You can do it when you try, so keep at it properly... okay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「No... ahaha, it's only because you're such a good teacher.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not true at all. Seeing that just now really made me realize you've got real talent, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」
Ria―senpai steps right up close and gently places her hand on my head―

name: Ria
message: 「Well done♪」
I ended up getting patted on the head.

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm? What's wrong?」
It's hard to tell her to stop just because I'm embarrassed. Actually, it feels really nice too.
Still, doesn't this mean I'm being treated like a kid……?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai. You shouldn't let Synn get any more carried away.」

name: Ria
message: 「You think so? Some kids actually grow when you praise them, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-That's not what I meant…… um……」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, I get it. You want one too, don't you, Nanaka-chan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Oh, no…… I'm good.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then, let me take her place!!」

name: Ria
message: 「If you do well in practice, okay?\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes…… I'll do my be~st\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hold on, Vice President. It'll be a problem if you don't properly wait your turn.」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I thought you were being quiet, so you were getting ready!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In matters like this, striking first is the key to victory. Now, let's get fired up~~!」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph, not bad. I won't let myself lose either. Come on, get ready too, Nanaka-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehh, me too!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Do your best, everyone~~」
With various thoughts swirling around, everyone throws themselves into training.

name: Ria
message: 「Was what you got earlier not quite enough?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「You're not a kid either, after all, Synn-kun……. I have to give you a proper reward.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A reward?」
Ria-senpai took out a stamp and smiled brightly. Ah, so that's what she meant.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I have it. I'll get it out right now」
She stamps the stamp card with a pop.

name: Ria
message: 「Keep up the good work next time too\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yes!!」
I wonder what happens once this is completely filled up……?
